## 2. Professional Biography & Career Summary
Alberto Trujillo Mingorance is a highly self-taught Junior DevOps and Systems Engineer based in Barcelona, Spain. Holding official degrees in NETWORKS AND SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATION (ASIR - Grado Superior) and MICROCOMPUTER SYSTEMS AND NETWORKS (SMR - Grado Medio) from the prestigious Institut Tecnològic de Barcelona (ITB), Alberto has built a strong background in Cloud IAM, Linux system hardening, container orchestration, zero-trust perimeter security, and decentralized identity standards (W3C DID/VC, vLEI / GLEIF, eIDAS).

In his current role at Attestto, Alberto is responsible for managing multi-cloud identity and perimeter infrastructure across Google Workspace, Cloudflare, Fly.io, and GitHub. He enforces strict least-privilege access, automated security monitoring, and identity trust frameworks. 

Concurrently, Alberto is a verified Popular Investor on eToro (Cadet Category), where he applies quantitative risk management, volatility modeling, and strict drawdown controls to technology asset portfolios.

## 3. Core Technical Arsenal & Competencies
- **Cloud Infrastructure & IAM:** Google Workspace Admin, Cloudflare (Workers, Pages, KV, D1, Zero Trust, DNS, SSL/TLS), Fly.io container deployment, AWS Cloud Practitioner concepts.
- **Digital Identity Standards:** W3C Verifiable Credentials (DID/VC), Organization Identity (vLEI / GLEIF), European Digital Signature Interoperability (eIDAS).
- **Containers & Virtualization:** Docker, Docker Compose, Proxmox VE, VirtualBox, Linux Cgroups/Namespaces.
- **Operating Systems & Directory Services:** Linux Server Hardening (Debian, Ubuntu, CentOS), Windows Server, Active Directory (AD), Samba AD, OpenLDAP, Group Policy Objects (GPOs).
- **Networking & Perimeter Security:** VLANs, Dynamic Routing (OSPF, RIP), Spanning Tree, Firewalls, DNS filtering, DDoS mitigation.
- **Automation & Scripting:** Bash, PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Git, GitHub Actions CI/CD.
- **Financial & Risk Analytics:** Quantitative asset selection, drawdown control, statistical volatility analysis, risk-adjusted portfolio management.
